professionalProfile: Dedicated IT professional and final-year Networks & Systems Administration student with over 5 years of hands-on experience managing complex IT infrastructure. Proven expertise spanning physical LAN/WLAN deployments, Linux server administration, and cloud-based application hosting. Adept at bridging the gap between technical execution and organizational leadership to deliver secure, highly available network environments.

bullets: Manage and operate an independent business dedicated to the physical installation, configuration, and maintenance of commercial and residential Wi-Fi hotspots.
Handle end-to-end network deployments, from sourcing hardware and managing ISP connections to configuring access points and ensuring optimal network performance for clients.
Architected and deployed campus-wide Wi-Fi hotspots, integrating services from major ISPs (including Starlink and Liquid Intelligent Technologies) to ensure 99% network uptime.
Administered robust IT infrastructure, enforcing network security through firewall configurations, malware protection, and Active Directory group policy deployments.
Maintained and optimized institutional database systems and Linux-based servers, utilizing advanced package management and terminal operations for system updates and monitoring.
Instructed comprehensive computer practicals and supervised lab sessions, translating complex hardware and software concepts for student comprehension.
Managed daily operations of university computing facilities, enforcing hardware maintenance schedules and data backup protocols.
Diagnosed and resolved complex hardware and network connectivity issues, actively monitoring traffic to prevent malware infections and network bottlenecks.
Provided comprehensive technical support to students and staff via phone, email, and in-person consultations.
Performed diagnostic tests and troubleshooting to identify and resolve hardware and software issues.

education.degree: Bachelor's Degree in Networks & Systems Administration

leadership.desc: Directed student governance initiatives, acted as a liaison between the student body and university administration, and managed execution of campus-wide programs.
